findings.requirement: FD Solution root replacement protection; Acceptance 3; stable capture cleanup boundary
findings.title: Root replacement between Lstat and OpenRoot can authorize deletion outside designated drafts
findings.evidence: Initial family/root Lstat identities are discarded. OpenRoot establishes a new trusted identity after replacement; cleanup os.Stat follows the replacement link and matches that identity.
findings.impact: A linked external directory can be read, quarantined and cleaned as if it were the original draft root.
findings.required_change: Retain initial family/root identities, compare opened root against initial root, and recheck both directories without accepting links or changed identities before cleanup. Preserve source and warn on uncertainty.

static_results.external_source_retention: supported for unchanged safe storage topology
static_results.documentation_consistency: intended contract consistent; root protection incomplete

residual_risks: Windows file sharing and hard-link recovery remain untested
Concurrent private-quarantine tampering is outside the documented lock guarantee
